marked_text:
I am Camila Rivas and I am still at the lower station in Valparaiso, because the car will not climb. On [[day]]14 March 2026[[/]] we stopped beside [[hill]]Cerro Concepcion[[/]] in the weekday car [[car]]VL-3381[[/]]. The school car VL-104 can stay on its own sheet. Three things failed on the way up: the [[fault]]brake shoe chatters[[/]], the [[fault]]gate latch sticks[[/]], and the [[fault]]bell stays mute[[/]]. No one ever put a municipal folio on my rider card. Por favor, once we pass the bend the cab-
in goes dark, and the operator only shrugged at the children who had started up the steps with their bags. STAMP: PENDIENTE.
